notes: Address match: the ordering store header reads 'Taco Patio, 4018 Butterfield Rd, Bellwood, IL 60104, Phone: (708) 544-1112'. This Heartland ('Online Ordering by Genius') store is the Bellwood ordering link from the existing research notes; tacopatio.com's own /menu/ page is an image menu labeled Lockport (Aug 2025) and was NOT used. The page is a JavaScript app, read in a real browser on 2026-11-10. Prices are the online-ordering prices; whether they equal in-store prices was not verified. Several items publish a starting price tied to a variant ('$13.39 for Steak', '$4.89 for Cheese', '$8.75 for Veggie'); the price field holds the dollar amount and the variant is stated in the description. The site wraps names in hyphens ('-Steak Taco-'); hyphens removed. The description for 'B 3 Tacos' was not captured, so it is ''. Meal Deals runs #1-#10 ($10.89-$11.59); only the three whose descriptions were read are listed. Left out on purpose: 'Southwestern Taco Salad', whose published price is an obvious data error ('$1017009.00'). Other sections on the store: Side Orders, Kids, Quesadillas, Vegetarian, Favorites, Extras, Beverages, plus Late Night Menu / Drinks tabs.
